page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor and built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU operates on a dedicated physical core without hyperthreading, ensuring predictable performance.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data storage needs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density position this instance for enterprise workloads requiring consistent, non-shared compute performance. Suitable workloads include enterprise application servers, medium-to-large databases, web serving fleets, and general-purpose business applications that require high memory capacity alongside substantial compute resources without the need for hardware acceleration.
